title: Constructing RNA-Protein Devices for Photochemical Regulation in Mammalian Cells

steps.title: Prepare first‑round PCR for ORF
steps.instruction: Assemble a 25 µL PCR mix containing 12.5 µL 2× PrimeSTAR Max Premix, 0.75 µL (0.3 µM) forward primer, 0.75 µL (0.3 µM) reverse primer, 0.5 ng template pDNA (0.02 ng/µL, variable volume), and nuclease‑free water to 25 µL.

steps.title: Prepare first‑round PCR for 3′ UTR
steps.instruction: Assemble a 50 µL PCR mix containing 25 µL 2× PrimeSTAR Max Premix, 1.5 µL (0.3 µM) KEC‑40 primer, 1.5 µL (0.3 µM) KEC‑65 primer, 1.5 µL (0.3 nM) template DNA, and nuclease‑free water to 50 µL.

steps.title: Run first‑round PCR
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tubes in a thermocycler and run: 98 °C 10 s denaturation, 55 °C 5 s annealing, 72 °C 5 s per kb extension, for 20–35 cycles, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Digest ORF PCR product with DpnI
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL DpnI to each ORF‑containing PCR tube and incubate 37 °C for 0.5–1 h to remove template plasmid; skip this step for the 3′ UTR PCR.

steps.title: Check PCR products by agarose gel
steps.instruction: Mix ~2 µL of each PCR reaction with loading dye, run on a 1.2 % agarose gel at 100 V for 25 min, stain with Midori Green Advance, and image to confirm expected band sizes.

steps.title: Purify first‑round PCR products
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified DNA using a DNA purification kit (e.g., Monarch PCR & DNA Cleanup Kit) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Quantify purified DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a spectrophotometer (e.g., NanoDrop 2000) and record the values.

steps.title: Assemble second‑round PCR for IVT templates
steps.instruction: For each construct, prepare a 50 µL reaction containing 25 µL 2× PrimeSTAR Max Premix, 1.5 µL (0.3 µM) forward primer, 1.5 µL (0.3 µM) reverse primer, 37 ng (10 nM) 3′ UTR PCR product, 1 ng (0.02–0.02 ng/µL) first‑round ORF PCR product, and water to 50 µL.

steps.title: Run second‑round PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 98 °C 10 s denaturation, 55 °C 5 s annealing, 72 °C 5 s per kb extension, for 35 cycles, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Validate and purify final IVT templates
steps.instruction: Repeat agarose‑gel electrophoresis (1.2 % gel, 100 V, 25 min) to confirm a single band, purify the DNA with a cleanup kit, and quantify; ensure concentration > 90 ng/µL.

steps.title: Set up in‑vitro transcription (IVT)
steps.instruction: For each mRNA, assemble a 10 µL IVT mix: 1 µL 10× T7 Reaction Buffer, 0.6 µL G(5′)ppp(5′)A cap analog (100 mM) for 1×MS2(U)site1/2 (or 1 µL ARCA cap analog 100 mM for other mRNAs) to reach 6 mM final, 0.2 µL GTP (75 mM) for 1.5 mM, 0.2 µL ATP (75 mM) for 7.5 mM, 1 µL CTP (75 mM) for 7.5 mM, 0.75 µL N1‑methyl‑pseudoUTP (100 mM) for 7.5 mM, 1 µL T7 enzyme mix, and 400 ng template DNA (40 ng/µL).

steps.title: Incubate transcription reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the IVT mixture at 37 °C for 4–6 h in a constant‑temperature incubator (avoid block heater to prevent evaporation).

steps.title: Digest template DNA with TURBO DNase
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL TURBO DNase to each IVT reaction and incubate 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Purify transcribed mRNA
steps.instruction: Clean up the RNA using an RNA purification kit (e.g., NEB Monarch RNA Cleanup Kit) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Dephosphorylate mRNA
steps.instruction: Mix purified RNA with 4 µL 10× rApid alkaline phosphatase buffer and 1 µL rApid alkaline phosphatase (1 U/µL, 25 mU/µL final) and bring the volume to 40 µL with nuclease‑free water; incubate 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Purify dephosphorylated mRNA
steps.instruction: Purify the dephosphorylated RNA again using an RNA cleanup kit as per the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Measure mRNA concentration
steps.instruction: Determine RNA concentration by absorbance spectroscopy (e.g., NanoDrop).

steps.title: Assess mRNA size and quality
steps.instruction: Analyze each RNA sample on a Bioanalyzer with the RNA 6000 Pico kit (or alternative methods such as denaturing PAGE) to confirm a single peak (except 2×ScMS2(C) which may show two peaks).

steps.title: Seed HeLa cells
steps.instruction: Plate 5 × 10⁴ HeLa cells in 500 µL DMEM + FBS + antibiotics per well of a 24‑well clear flat‑bottom plate; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until 70‑90 % confluent (≈1 day).

steps.title: Prepare mRNA transfection mixtures
steps.instruction:
For each well, dilute the required mRNAs in 25 µL Opti‑MEM to achieve the following amounts (examples):
- Split CaVT activation: 320 ng 1×MS2(U)site1, 100 ng control reporter, 20 ng MS2CP‑eDHFR, 60 ng HaloTag‑VPg(FCV).
- DD‑CaVT activation: 360 ng 1×MS2(U)site2, 100 ng control reporter, 40 ng DD‑CaVT.
- DD‑CaVT repression: 80 ng 2×ScMS2(C), 100 ng control reporter, 40 ng DD‑CaVT.
Adjust volumes accordingly for each condition.

steps.title: Prepare Lipofectamine MessengerMAX mixture
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL Lipofectamine MessengerMAX in 25 µL Opti‑MEM per well; incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Form transfection complexes and add to cells
steps.instruction: Combine the 25 µL diluted mRNA solution with the 25 µL diluted Lipofectamine solution, mix gently, and incubate 5 min at room temperature; then add the 50 µL complex directly to the cell culture medium and incubate 3 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare ligand‑containing medium
steps.instruction: Make fresh DMEM containing either 250 nM photocaged TMP‑HL (for split CaVT experiments) or 10 µM photocaged TMP (for DD‑CaVT experiments); keep plates protected from light. Use non‑caged TMP‑HL/TMP as positive controls if desired.

steps.title: Replace medium with ligand‑containing medium
steps.instruction: Three hours after transfection, aspirate the old medium and add 500 µL of the appropriate ligand‑containing medium to each well; wrap control plates in aluminum foil to prevent accidental decaging.

steps.title: Irradiate cells with UV light
steps.instruction: Place the plates on an HP‑30LM UV lamp and expose to 365 nm light from the bottom for 3–7 min (intensity ≈3.34 mW/cm²). Perform this step in a UV‑shielded clean bench; adjust time if using a different UV source.

steps.title: Incubate post‑irradiation
steps.instruction: Return the plates to the 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and culture for an additional 1 day.

steps.title: Harvest cells for flow analysis
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 0.25 % Trypsin/EDTA per well, incubate briefly, then add 500 µL fresh medium to neutralize; collect the cell suspension, pass through a cell strainer, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Analyze the strained cell suspension on a flow cytometer according to the instrument’s instructions to quantify reporter fluorescence.

description: A photocaged ligand (photocaged Trimethoprim-HaloTag ligand (TMP-HL) for split CaVT and photocaged trimethoprim (TMP) for destabilizing domain-fused CaVT (DD-CaVT), respectively) is necessary for photochemical translational regulation of synthetic mRNAs by split CaVT or DD-CaVT.
